entry_long: ADX(14) > 10 and ADX rising now after falling previously (V-turn in ADX) and close > EMA(20) and close > second EMA(20).

implementation_notes: Both MA lengths default to 20 (inputs allow different types/lengths). Short exit mirrors long.
